note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used declaratively by the MMSegmentation framework to configure training of the Sapiens 0.6B model for human parsing segmentation on the CIHP dataset at 1024x768 resolution.
run_training: run the sapiens 0.6b human parsing segmentation model training on the CIHP dataset using mmsegmentation with this config file
review_model_config: review the sapiens 0.6b encoder-decoder model configuration including backbone vision transformer and vit head decode settings
review_optimizer_config: review the adamw optimizer configuration with layer decay rate 0.85 and 32 layers for the sapiens model
review_dataset_config: review the CIHP dataset train and validation dataloader configuration with augmentation pipeline settings
review_class_weights: review the 20 class weights for human parsing including background hat hair clothing and body parts
